subject.title: fix(slack): reconcile ambiguous sends before replay

question: Should OpenClaw accept the additive internal channel SDK durable-send fields and per-kind reconciliation capability map as the contract for Slack exact unknown-send reconciliation?
rationale: The remaining code defects are mechanical, but the PR changes exported channel/plugin type surfaces and therefore needs maintainer intent beyond CI.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Fix the Slack scanner and setup-scope gaps, then accept the additive internal SDK surface as the narrow contract needed for exact Slack text reconciliation.

options.title: Keep Slack-local
options.body: Ask the author to avoid expanding exported channel types and keep the reconciliation state inside the Slack/core boundary if maintainers do not want this SDK seam.

options.title: Defer to broader contract
options.body: Pause this PR and fold the design into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 if maintainers want the cross-channel durable-delivery contract settled first.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the Slack scanner and setup-scope gaps, then accept the additive internal SDK surface as the narrow contract needed for exact Slack text reconciliation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current rewrite commits and is closest to the concrete Slack/core delivery seam in this PR.
